name: Probe
description: Measures agent run cost, speed, and behavior over a time window (tokens, time breakdown, tool/skill usage, errors, raw LLM request/response archive) via /probe chat commands, for before/after experiments on agent changes.

openclawBin.label: OpenClaw CLI binary
openclawBin.help: Binary name or path used to shell out to `openclaw audit --json` and `openclaw plugins list --json`. Change only if `openclaw` is not on PATH for the Gateway process.

cliTimeoutMs.label: CLI call timeout (ms)
cliTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for each `openclaw audit`/`openclaw plugins list` subprocess call.

llmLog.enabled.label: Capture raw LLM request/response
llmLog.enabled.help: Hook llm_input/llm_output to archive full request/response payloads per probe window. Requires plugins.entries.probe.hooks.allowConversationAccess=true in config - see README. Core metrics (tokens, time, tool/skill usage, errors) work without this.

llmLog.maxFileSizeMb.label: Max raw log file size (MB)
llmLog.maxFileSizeMb.help: Rotate the day's raw LLM log file once it exceeds this size.

llmLog.maxFiles.label: Max rotated raw log files
llmLog.maxFiles.help: How many rotated raw LLM log files to keep before deleting the oldest.

llmLog.redactSecrets.label: Redact secret-shaped values
llmLog.redactSecrets.help: Redact values that look like API keys/tokens/JWTs in the captured raw request/response before writing to disk (recommended).
